thread:
alana: quick sync — kicking off joint perf/W smoke runs with Neptune next week. target is to validate throughput and watt curves across a small matrix so we can scope a public benchmark. @marco can Neptune provide continuous power telemetry + per-core clock traces? :wave:
marco: yes, we can stream power via SNMP and push CSV artifacts after each run. we can also instrument per-core clocks if you mount the telemetry agent. we recommend the `neptune-kernel` tune set for initial sweeps.
dmitri: what model/seq len are we using as the baseline? i suggest neo-3b at seq=1024 and a 13b check at 512. we should pin tokenizer + prompt to avoid tokenisation variance.
katie: timeline check — product wants a joint customer-facing blog in ~3 weeks. that gives eng ~2 weeks for full matrix and data review. ok?
marco: 3 weeks is tight but doable if we get the kernel window now. need a 72h block for kernel iterations and another 24h for stabilized runs.
alana: proposed run matrix (short):
```
models: neo-3b, neo-13b
batch_sizes: 1,4,8
seq_len: 512,1024
quant: fp16, int8-q4
kernel_flags: neptune_opt=on, asm_prefetch=auto
telemetry: power@200ms, per_core_freq@1s
```
bench-bot: scheduled run created: https://redwood.example.com/bench/176800 - status: queued :gear:
katie: also want p50/p95/p99 latency, tail token counts, and perf/W at steady-state (last 5m). we'll call out the best perf/W config in the blog.
dmitri: add env var `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=1` and mount `/sys/devices/` for hardware counters. please run `scripts/collect-kernel.sh` right after each kernel build and attach the output. example command we will run: `./run_bench --model neo-3b --bs 4 --seq 1024 --quant fp16 --telemetry /tmp/run123`
marco: we'll supply the kernel patchset and a small helper to convert our SNMP stream to the bench CSV. also propose a 48h embargo after both teams sign off on the CSV for a joint announcement.
alana: ack on embargo. i'll draft a timeline and send a calendar invite for the 72h kernel tuning window. tagging @marco for availability.
marco: thanks — i'll confirm engineer names and send access keys by EOD.
katie: perfect, next sync Mon 10am PT. :calendar:
bench-bot: run started (dry-run) 1768001500 — logs: https://redwood.example.com/bench/176800/logs
alana: nice — if we see >5% perf delta after the kernel patch we loop in runtime and asm leads.
marco: noted. we'll post the initial scoreboard CSV to the project bucket when the dry-run finishes.
